newsitem.title: UK: LCE white sugar ends quiet as Oct heads for expiry.
newsitem.headline: LCE white sugar ends quiet as Oct heads for expiry.

text.p: White sugar futures ended mixed after trading narrowly in moderate activity ahead of Friday's expiry of the near October contract.
By the close October was $0.80 a tonne up at $346.40 with other active positions up to $0.90 down for March and otherwise hardly changed to just firmer. Turnover was 3,589 lots.
A steady volume of trade switching of short positions from October to December and March had helped keep the market in a tight range.
But prices did slip slightly from the highs as New York raws futures came under some selling pressure. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7771
